channel.title: South Carolina Living Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from South Carolina Living Magazine (scliving.coop)

item.title: Your guide to saving energy and money with smart home electronics
item.description: Wouldn’t it be great to wake up, say, “Good morning, house!” and watch all the right lights and appliances come to life? Smart devices make it possible—and can make your home more efficient.

item.title: The Boykin Spaniel, 'the little brown dog,' is a special breed of SC history and heart
item.description: South Carolina's state dog has been bred for decades as a lovable, true partner in hunting and in the home. Find out why the love of the Boykin runs deep in our state.

item.title: Fringe is in: Bring this native tree to your SC garden landscape
item.description: Sometimes called “old man’s beard” (you can see why), the fringe tree brings a bit of whimsy and sturdiness to the Southeastern landscape.

item.title: Live and lettuce live
item.description: Old Aunt Gladys—not a blood relative, but crazy enough to be—took home gardening to a new level, Jan A. Igoe writes in a classic column.

item.title: This South Carolina candy shop is sweet in every season
item.description: Step inside Pendleton Candy Company, and it doesn't take long to see: Just like the likeness of Willy Wonka that stands in one corner of the shop, the three-woman team behind this sweets store believes in pure imagination.

item.title: Plan a steak out! Check out these meaty meals that won't break the bank
item.description: A steak-forward dinner doesn't have to be expensive. Use affordable cuts of beef such as sirloin, chuck, flank and skirt for these delicious recipes.

item.title: Steak tacos
item.description: Skirt steak marinated in lime juice, soy sauce and spices, grilled to medium rare, then sliced thin and loaded into warm corn tortillas with all the fixings.

item.title: Beef mushroom pot pie
item.description: Stewing beef and mushrooms braised in a rich wine sauce, topped with golden puff pastry and baked in individual ramekins.

item.title: Pepper steak and rice
item.description: Thinly sliced flank steak and colorful bell peppers in a savory soy-ginger sauce, served over rice. A classic stir-fry that comes together fast.

item.title: Garlic beef tips over pappardelle noodles
item.description: Sirloin cubes seared golden and finished in garlic butter, tossed with wide pappardelle noodles for a quick, satisfying dinner.
